method: Whitespace count from actual p.teaching-prose elements only, stripping inline markup and decoding &; article count includes supplemental text but excludes SVG and button contents.

comparator.comparison: Same reader shell, connected explanatory paragraphs, distinct concepts and quantitative inference; exact duplicates absent and no pair exceeded 0.65 Jaccard word-set similarity in pre-final draft.

scope_review: Revised merged CSIR Unit 3.D printed page 4, separate CSIR printed page 3 and archived MP SET 2024 printed page 3 visually checked. Academy 3.D.06 scope mapped to 24 theory sections. No procedural virus engineering or detailed pathogenesis, taxonomy or replication chapter duplication.

coverage_audit.mechanisms: dna, nuclear, splicing, rna, reverse, plant, protein-processing, initiation
coverage_audit.applications: comparison, historical evidence and conceptual research interpretation

review_pass_1: Separate internal scientific review checked genome-to-message routes, RNA charge versus polarity, adenovirus early/late and splicing evidence, poxvirus exception, retroviral and DNA-RT distinction, host-dependent translation, TMV subgenomic messages, Potyviridae polyprotein and equations; clarified simple pathway interruption, corrected rate notation, added primary references and avoided real-virus intervention recipes.
review_pass_2: Separate internal teaching review reordered 24 theory sections into conceptual progression; replaced ten preliminary repetitive box figures with twelve distinct schematics/graphs; clarified figure 4 arbitrary relative scale; added why-and-exam framing to all 18 traps, four integrated/figure questions, explicit worked examples, six mastery criteria and source links. Verified 54 keys and 29 arithmetic checks.

academic_self_review.method: Internal rubric judgment based on saved-file review; deductions for representative rather than exhaustive source reading, some recurring rate-versus-stock framing, hypothetical rather than primary quantitative datasets, assessment distractors not externally calibrated, and static rather than device-level reader testing. This is not independent expert peer review.

limitations: MP SET comparator archived, not verified against an official current MPPSC-hosted edition.
Selected scientific abstracts, institutional sources and accessible reviews checked; not all full papers read.
Static HTML/SVG source checks, not complete interactive browser/mobile or independent accessibility testing.
